title: Nutanix VM Provisioning
description: Provisions a single Nutanix AHV VM by cloning an approved pre-hardened template, resizing the OS disk and adding data disks, attaching a vNIC to a temp provisioning port group, injecting OS-family-specific guest customization, and creating a pre-CIS hardening checkpoint.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: nutanix_host
parameters.description: Prism Central hostname or IP address.

parameters.name: vm_name
parameters.description: Name of the VM to provision.

parameters.name: template_name
parameters.description: Name of the approved pre-hardened template to clone.

parameters.name: os_family
parameters.description: Guest OS family: windows or rhel.

parameters.name: os_disk_gb
parameters.description: OS disk size in GB (resizes the inherited template OS disk).

parameters.name: data_disks_gb
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of data disk sizes in GB (empty string means no data disks).

parameters.name: port_group_name
parameters.description: Name of the temp provisioning port group (subnet) to attach the vNIC to.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Hostname to configure on the guest via guest customization.

playbook_output.description: Emits vm_name, vm_ext_id, template_name, os_family, cpu_sockets, cpu_cores_per_socket, memory_gb, os_disk_gb, data_disks_gb, port_group_name, hostname, checkpoint_name, and status.

fields.name: vm_ext_id
fields.description: External ID of the provisioned VM.

fields.name: template_name
fields.description: Name of the template used for cloning.

fields.name: data_disks_gb
fields.description: Comma-separated list of data disk sizes in GB.

fields.name: port_group_name
fields.description: Name of the temp provisioning port group.

fields.name: checkpoint_name
fields.description: Name of the pre-CIS hardening checkpoint.

steps.name: Look up template UUID by name
steps.function: Query Nutanix Prism Central for the image matching the given template name.

steps.name: Extract template UUID from lookup result
steps.function: Extract the template external ID from the image lookup result.

computations._template_uuid: Extract the ext_id of the first matching image from _template_lookup.

steps.name: Does the template exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether the template lookup found a matching image.
steps.condition: The template lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Look up port group UUID by name
steps.function: Query Nutanix Prism Central for the subnet matching the given port group name.

steps.name: Does the port group exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether the port group lookup found a matching subnet.
steps.condition: The port group lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Extract port group UUID from lookup result
steps.function: Extract the subnet external ID from the port group lookup result.

computations._subnet_uuid: Extract the ext_id of the first matching subnet from _subnet_lookup.

steps.name: Is the selected OS family Windows?
steps.function: Branch on the selected OS family to choose the correct guest customization path.
steps.condition: The selected OS family is Windows.

steps.name: Clone VM with OS-family-specific guest customization
steps.function: Clone the approved pre-hardened template into a new VM with the requested CPU, RAM, vNIC on the temp provisioning port group, and OS-family-specific guest customization (Windows unattend or RHEL cloud-init with DHCP and hostname).

steps.name: Look up cloned VM ext_id by name
steps.function: Query Nutanix Prism Central for the newly cloned VM by name to obtain its external ID.

steps.name: Extract cloned VM ext_id from lookup result
steps.function: Extract the external ID of the cloned VM from the VM lookup result.

computations._vm_ext_id: Extract the ext_id of the first matching VM from _vm_lookup.

steps.name: Resize OS disk and add data disks
steps.function: Resize the inherited OS disk to the requested size and add each requested data disk to the cloned VM.

steps.name: Create pre-CIS hardening checkpoint
steps.function: Create a pre-CIS hardening checkpoint (snapshot) of the provisioned VM.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block on success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Resolve template and port group names to UUIDs and validate they exist.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Clone the VM with OS-family-specific guest customization, resize the OS disk, add data disks, and create the pre-CIS checkpoint.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured provisioning evidence to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
